    title='global_task_303a88c0_rule_L_pocket_twin_recolor_to_border_v6_SOLVED',
    content=(
        "task-303a88c0 SOLVED (final instance: 0 wrong, 2 demos; supersedes v1/v3/v5 readings).\n"
        "RULE (verified on 2 demos + correct test submission): Grid = background + an L-shaped "
        "border object (the 'frame', its own color) + small objects + single-cell noise pieces of a "
        "noise color (e.g. 0s/3-singletons in demos; domino+singleton in test). The L-border's "
        "CONCAVE pocket (region between its arms, bounded by grid edges) contains exactly one small "
        "object. Somewhere OUTSIDE the pocket there is a TWIN object with the SAME shape as the "
        "pocket object (demo1: identical orientation; test: identical orientation; demo2: both "
        "single cells). Recolor the OUTSIDE twin to the L-BORDER's color. Everything else unchanged "
        "(noise, pocket contents, border all stay).\n"
        "Demo1: 6-L border, 8-obj inside pocket, 5-twin outside -> 5-obj became 6. Demo2: 9-L border, "
        "single 0 inside pocket, single 8 outside -> that cell became 9. Test: 4-L border (corner "
        "(13,10), arms down+right), 7-shape XX/XX/X./X. inside pocket, identical 8-shape just left of "
        "the border -> recolored those 6 cells 8->4. Scattered shapes that match nothing and noise are "
        "left alone.\n"
        "Method notes: find connected components per color; identify the L-border (largest L-shaped "
        "component); compute its concave pocket; find the object inside; match other components by "
        "shape (normalize cells to min-corner; exact match sufficed in all 3 cases); recolor the "
        "outside match to the border color. Build submission grid programmatically in the REPL, "
        "never hand-type."
    ),
    global_=True,
)
print(entry)
